title: Fix arithmetic underflow in Fragment::from_bytes for malformed ALL_1 inputs
description: Fragment::from_bytes panics in debug mode (or returns misleading error in release) when given a short message (5-6 bytes) with ALL_1 FCN bits set. Line 184 computes `payload_len = content_len - content_offset` before validating that content_len is large enough. Move the validation before the subtraction, or use checked_sub.
close_reason: Fixed: Moved ALL_1 content_len validation before payload_len subtraction to prevent arithmetic underflow. Added regression test for short ALL_1 inputs.
